# Recovery And Installer Requirements Checklist: macOS Passthrough Release Hardening

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for route recovery, sleep/wake, `coreaudiod` restart, and installer lifecycle regression.
**Created**: 2026-06-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [X] CHK001 Are physical microphone change, physical output change, aggregate or multi-output route, Bluetooth route, and stale browser device-ID behavior all required as evidence outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [X] CHK002 Is `coreaudiod` restart recovery required both after install and during or after passthrough readiness? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [X] CHK003 Are sleep/wake requirements defined for driver publication, app readiness, and safe stale or recheck state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [X] CHK004 Are install, update, repair, rollback, uninstall, and reinstall flows all included in the installer lifecycle requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]

## Requirement Clarity

- [X] CHK005 Is the recovery timing threshold for route changes and `coreaudiod` restart quantified? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004]
- [X] CHK006 Are acceptable recovery outcomes limited to ready after valid evidence or truthful stale/degraded/blocked/repair states? [Clarity, Spec §US3 Acceptance Scenarios, Spec §FR-011]
- [X] CHK007 Is "without manual hidden cleanup" defined enough to prevent undocumented file or process cleanup from becoming part of acceptance? [Clarity, Spec §SC-006]
- [X] CHK008 Are meeting-app-selected-device edge cases during repair/update/uninstall explicitly in scope for requirements? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [X] CHK009 Are recovery requirements consistent with the fail-closed model and the rule that stale ready UI must not remain visible? [Consistency, Spec §Constitutional Requirements, Spec §US3]
- [X] CHK010 Are installer lifecycle requirements consistent with local-only validation and no new server/storage workflows? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Plan §Storage]
- [X] CHK011 Are route recovery evidence outcomes consistent with the common result values `passed`, `blocked`, and `not_accepted`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Contract evidence]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [X] CHK012 Can each route recovery and installer lifecycle scenario be recorded with objective metadata-only evidence? [Measurability, Spec §Key Entities, Contract evidence]
- [X] CHK013 Are blocked and not-accepted recovery outcomes allowed and distinguishable from passed outcomes? [Measurability, Spec §FR-005, Spec §SC-006]
- [X] CHK014 Are sleep/wake requirements measurable without requiring meeting-content recording or transcript artifacts? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, Spec §FR-012]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [X] CHK015 Are browser stale device IDs after `coreaudiod` restart covered as a separate recovery risk? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
